summary: Zone Frontier (f/k/a CleanCore Solutions) filed an 8-K reporting that on October 7, 2026 it entered into and simultaneously closed an Asset Purchase Agreement with Sanzonate Holdings LLC, a Nevada LLC controlled by director Clayton Adams, selling substantially all of its legacy cleaning-products business. The transferred package comprises 100% of Irish subsidiary CleanCore Global Limited, $500,000 cash, ozone-generation patents, CLEANCORE marks, receivables, inventory, equipment, the Omaha lease, and assumed liabilities. Zone Frontier retained excess cash, digital assets, and its 79% Minnesota data center JV interest, and must cease CleanCore name use. Because the buyer is a related party, conflict-of-interest and valuation scrutiny are the key watch items; no price, premium, or advisor was disclosed.
